title: Implement exponential backoff retry jitter calculator
prompt: Implement the missing method `calculate_backoff_ms` on `BackoffPolicy` in `src/lib.rs`. It must compute exponential backoff duration given an attempt count (0-indexed): base_ms * (multiplier ^ attempt), clamped to max_ms, and returned as u64. For attempt 0, it returns base_ms. Ensure `cargo test` passes cleanly.
acceptance: All unit tests in tests/test_backoff.rs pass cleanly
